question: Who among the following formed a group of non-violent revolutionaries, the Khudai Khidmatgars (known as Red Shirts)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khan Abdul Gaffar Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Khan Abdul Gaffar Khan, also known as **"Frontier Gandhi,"** was a close associate of Mahatma Gandhi and a prominent leader in the Indian freedom struggle.
 
• He founded the **Khudai Khidmatgar (Servants of God) movement** in 1929, popularly known as the "Red Shirts."
